reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended There are no active review issues for the update to include thinking tokens in Vertex AI completion-token usage. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Updates the Python Vertex AI connectors to include thinking tokens in completion-token usage, aligning their accounting with the Google AI connector change in #14671. **Changes:** - Both chat and text services now report candidate tokens plus thinking tokens as `completion_tokens`. - Adds a regression test for each service verifying that 10 candidate tokens and 40 thinking tokens produce 50 completion tokens. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `python/​tests/​unit/​connectors/​ai/​google/​vertex_ai/​services/​test_vertex_ai_text_completion.py` | Tests text-completion usage with thinking tokens. | | `python/​tests/​unit/​connectors/​ai/​google/​vertex_ai/​services/​test_vertex_ai_chat_completion.py` | Tests chat-completion usage with thinking tokens. | | `python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​google/​vertex_ai/​services/​vertex_ai_text_completion.py` | Includes thinking tokens in text-completion usage. | | `python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​google/​vertex_ai/​services/​vertex_ai_chat_completion.py` | Includes thinking tokens in chat-completion usage. |
Review effort: Balanced
